Trishakti Power Generation Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Gujarat · IN 
 
 No. CC/8/2013/080 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Stormwater Drainage - Gujarat Pkg-80" (sewerage drainage), awarded to
 M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 2013-03-12 at a gross executed value of INR 28.38 Cr (Rupees 28.38 Crore Only).
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
 completion of the final inspection. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Farhan Roy. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
